note: Blank recipe for a Game Boy look: Crystal Lens's own files, at the Game Boy's sizes. Replace null with piece numbers from your slice preview and delete the sections you don't need; anything left out falls back to the character's other looks. The packed files go at the look folder's top level, where Crystal Lens reads them too. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

_how.piece: a number from the slice preview, e.g. 12
_how.one-row sections: can be a plain list, e.g. "front": [12]

_sections.front: frontColor.png: 1 frame, 56x56. battle front pic, also the trainer card when there's no trainer card pic
_sections.back: backColor.png: 1 frame, 48x48. battle back pic (the Game Boy has no throw)
_sections.trainer card: trainerCardColor.png: 1 frame, 40x56. Crystal Lens's Gen 2 trainer card portrait (optional)
_sections.walk: overworldWalk.png: 2 down, 2 up, 2 left, 16x16. stand, step (the game mirrors the step); four shades, coloured by overworldColors
_sections.bike: overworldBike.png: 2 down, 2 up, 2 left, 16x16. stand, pedal; four shades
_sections.surf: overworldSurf.png: 2 down, 2 up, 2 left, 16x16. stand, step; what shows while surfing and diving (the Game Boy shows only the Pokémon, but it can be anything). Emerald Lens only; four shades
_sections.fish down: overworldFishFront.png: 1 frame, 16x8. the bottom half while fishing facing down; the standing frame's top half goes above it. four shades
_sections.fish up: overworldFishBack.png: 1 frame, 16x8. the bottom half while fishing facing up
_sections.fish left: overworldFishSide.png: 1 frame, 16x8. the bottom half while fishing facing left (right is mirrored)
_sections.rod: overworldFishRod.png: 2 frames, 8x8. the rod for down and up, then for left, placed as Gen 1's. Emerald Lens only; without it, the rod comes from an installed game
